scope: Ten social/digital candidate records and their local source references

results.json_parse: All own candidate records parse; wider research JSON parse check also passed.
results.original_fragments: All ten claim fragments matched archived submission text after whitespace normalisation. Requests matched where an embedded or registry mapping was available; the shared DZV request was checked directly earlier.
results.counter_fragments: Archived main counter quotations matched their sources. Two-column academic PDFs required ordinary reading-order extraction and removal of line-ending word hyphenation; no wording was altered. Some sources remain web-only and are labelled as such.
results.reviews: All linked independent review files exist.
results.protected_fields: Manual prose cleanup asserted unchanged originals, underlines, identifiers, URLs, filenames and hashes. A subsequently discovered misplaced DNA description was corrected by selecting source ID; this was a metadata editing error, not a source change.
results.archive_integrity: All recorded local_file/ministry_local_file paths across research resolve. Referenced PDFs have PDF signatures. A final pass checked all 30 recorded local-file/SHA-256 pairs across research, including newly archived primary sources and register metadata; all matched. The register HTML is explicitly distinguished from its unavailable binary attachment.
results.submission_quote_budget: Own submission-source verbatim fragments, including shared requests stored once: BÄK 25 words; HateAid 25; DZVhÄ 20; BDA 14; EGGD 20; Pharma Deutschland 15. No additional submission quotations were introduced by the final reassessment.
results.late_substantive_correction: Original DSHS annual report revealed different total-volume and completed-treatment analytic bases. Earlier approximate derived share was withdrawn from active finding and superseded in independent review history; see candidate and reassessment records.
results.aggregate_quote_integrity: Compared the ten own records against the compiled findings and unresolved-lead files: every claim/counter original and underline matched. Later contextual and metadata edits still require the final rebuild.

limits: This integrity check does not replace the separately recorded independent AI reviews or establish that every assertion in archived submissions was verified. No specialist review or author response is represented.
